<thinking>Now that I have the directory structure, I can start implementing the new requirements. I will begin with the simplest ones and ensure that existing tests continue to pass. I will track my progress and ensure that all changes are reflected in the public namespace and documentation accordingly.</thinking>

### Requirement [R1] - Compose Left Function
I need to add a function `compose_left` that performs left-to-right composition of functions.

### Requirement [R2] - Peekn Function
I need to add a function `peekn` that takes an integer `n` and an iterable, yielding the first `n` items while consuming them from the input iterator.

### Requirement [R3] - Optimized Dissociation Function
I need to optimize the `dissoc` function for dictionary deletion operations.

### Requirement [R4] - Compose Class
I need to add a class or callable named `Compose` that supports function composition.

### Requirement [R5] - Parallel Fold Function
I need to add parallel execution capabilities to the `fold` function.

### Requirement [R6] - Mapping Merge Functions
I need to update `merge` and `merge_with` functions to accept any Mapping type as input.

### Requirement [R7] - Python 3 Compatibility
I need to ensure that all listed functions operate exclusively in Python 3 environments.

### Requirement [R8] - Python 3.10 Support
I need to provide correct type signatures and runtime behavior for Python 3.10.

Here's the implementation for Requirement [R1] - `compose_left`.
